question: Unterscheiden sich offizieller und gemischter Arm extern im Fehler bei 80 Prozent Abdeckung?
label_policy: OR of pneumonia diagnoses, including comorbidities; exclusive No finding negative; other positive findings descriptive control; conflicting No finding and any finding or no positive label excluded; malformed/duplicate/missing records abort
sample_size_decision: Keep official test: union lower bound 89 exceeds prespecified adequacy floor 80 (worst-case binomial 95 percent half-width about 11 percentage points). No power claim, no extension after observing results.
primary: R80: error in most confident 80 percent of pneumonia/normal cohort; equal fractional weight for boundary ties; no label-based tie breaking
contrast: official minus mixed; 5x5 paired training-seed contrasts, mean over splits and seeds; positive means mixed arm lower error
control: other findings: count, positive prediction fraction, fixed acceptance and mean confidence only; no invented negative labels

dicom.pipeline: decode; padding mask in stored values; modality LUT/rescale; first VOI LUT preferred else first window else unchanged; finite nonpadding min/max to [0,1]; MONOCHROME1 inversion; round to uint8; padding black; exact 512 Lanczos centered black letterbox; RGB replication and ImageNet normalization
dicom.constant_or_invalid_pixels: abort with generic error, no silent image loss

bootstrap.interval: 95 percent percentile; common cluster multiplicities across all 30 models, recompute R80 each draw
bootstrap.unit: StudyInstanceUID if present for every image; otherwise published one-study-per-image design, explicitly flagged study proxy. Patient linkage is removed; no patient-level independence claim.
bootstrap.outputs: arm means and paired contrast for R80, specificity, sensitivity, fixed acceptance, fixed accepted error; valid replicate counts; null when undefined

model_variation: training-seed means over splits and split means over training seeds separately: SD, min/max, t95 df4; no pooled 30-model independence assumption
zero_error: report accepted group count and one-sided 95 percent upper bound for probability a group has any accepted error when zero observed; bootstrap [0,0] does not mean zero risk
execution: CPU float32, eval, deterministic; frozen shared encoder allowed only after bitwise state equality check; no training, threshold fitting or repeated model selection
privacy: offline only; identifiers, labels, pixels and per-image predictions stay in local RAM; no per-image cache/log/export; only aggregate JSON; generic errors; no path or DICOM-tag output
